consequence.statement: New capability added; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators who do nothing.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for 3rd-party source controllers via the ExternalArtifact kind (source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1).

decision.reason: [ev-9ac7da44855f] lists ExternalArtifact support for 3rd-party source controllers only as a new-feature highlight. It says nothing breaks, is rejected or must be migrated. The canonical validator confirmed added/none, and the CRD validator confirmed from [ev-c2c6c790d6b2] that source.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1 ExternalArtifact first appears in this release. So the right consequence is none (informational) for an environment that does nothing.
